parsed.scene_summary: I leave my apartment, step into the elevator lobby, and wait by the elevators while watching the digital floor displays and adjusting my glasses.

segments.action: I reach forward and push down on the door handle with my right hand to open the apartment front door.
segments.action_brief: I open the apartment door.
segments.environment: Physical space: An apartment entryway leading to a residential floor corridor. The front door is a light wood veneer door with a silver metal handle, keyhole, door peephole, and a white paper notice affixed in the center. The wall to the left is painted teal-blue near the base and off-white above. The wall to the right features exposed red-brown faux brick with a white wall switch plate and an intercom or doorbell module. The entryway floor consists of light grey-beige wood-grain ceramic tiles. In the lower-right foreground, a small dark chair or bench holds plastic shopping bags, a small cardboard box, and assorted packaged items. Ceiling is white drywall with a recessed light/smoke detector. Dim indoor residential lighting. No other people present. Screen content: None. World text: Printed notice on the front door; small label on the wall switch. Media playing: None. Ambient audio: Quiet indoor silence.
segments.details: My right hand reaches out toward the metal lever handle of the apartment door, pushes it downwards, and swings the door open outward.

segments.action: I walk through the doorway into the elevator lobby toward the two elevators, extending my right hand toward the call button column.
segments.action_brief: I walk toward the elevators.
segments.environment: I step across the white door threshold into the brightly lit elevator lobby. The flooring changes to polished cream-colored square tiles. Directly ahead are two stainless-steel passenger elevator doors labeled '2' (on the left) and '1' (on the right), separated by a wide central pillar. Each elevator door jamb features a vertical brushed metal panel containing an upper fire warning notice, a central blue-and-white LED dot-matrix display, the large lift number numeral ('2' or '1'), and lower call buttons. Both elevators' downward arrow call buttons illuminate in blue.
segments.details: I take several steps forward onto the lobby floor tiles. I reach my right hand forward toward the button panel between the elevators, observing the lit call buttons.

segments.action: I stand in the lobby watching the digital floor displays as Lift 1 ascends from ground level past floors 1, 3, 5, and 6.
segments.action_brief: I watch the elevator floor indicators.
segments.environment: Lift 1's dot-matrix screen updates sequentially from '▲ G' to '▲ 1', '▲ 3', '▲ 5', and '▲ 6', showing upward transit. Lift 2's display transitions from '▼ G' to '▲ G'. Both down call buttons stay illuminated in bright blue.
segments.details: I lower my arm and remain stationary in front of the two elevators, tracking the dot-matrix floor indicator of Lift 1 on the right as it counts upwards.

segments.action: I raise my right hand to adjust the frame of my smart glasses on my face.
segments.action_brief: I adjust my smart glasses.
segments.environment: My right hand moves into the close upper foreground in front of the camera lens, temporarily occluding the central field of view. Behind my hand, Lift 1 reaches floor '▲ 9' while Lift 2 shows '▲ G'.
segments.details: I lift my right hand to touch and reposition the temple and rim of the smart glasses on my nose bridge.

segments.action: I continue waiting by the elevators while keeping my right hand near my glasses, monitoring Lift 1 as it ascends through floors 10, 11, 14, and 15.
segments.action_brief: I monitor the elevator floor indicators.
segments.environment: Lift 1's digital display advances through '▲ 10', '▲ 11', '▲ 14', and '▲ 15'. Lift 2's display updates to '▲ 1'. My hand lowers slightly and shifts in the upper foreground.
segments.details: I keep my gaze alternating between the floor and the elevator floor indicators, waiting for either elevator cabin to arrive at my floor.

parsed.scene_summary: I ride an elevator where another passenger enters on the 10th floor and presses a button, after which the doors close and I look down at the floor while holding a small spray bottle.

segments.action: I stand inside the elevator cabin facing the closed metal doors, observing the floor display showing '▼ 10' and the button panel.
segments.action_brief: I watch the elevator doors.
segments.environment: a) PHYSICAL SPACE: Interior of a residential/commercial passenger elevator cabin with brushed stainless steel walls, recessed warm circular spotlights in the ceiling, and a grey wood-grain patterned marble floor. b) OBJECTS: On the right wall beside the door, a vertical stainless steel elevator control panel with two vertical rows of illuminated circular buttons, an LED floor indicator screen, a safety plaque above the screen, and a framed A4-sized paper notice further down to the right. I hold a small light-green and white spray bottle with both hands in front of my waist. c) SCREEN CONTENT: The elevator LED matrix display shows a downward arrow and the floor number '▼ 10' in bright white/cyan digits against a black background. d) TEXT IN THE WORLD: Metal safety plate above the floor indicator reads '如遇火警 切勿使用升降機 / IN CASE OF FIRE DO NOT USE THE LIFT', 'LIFT NO. 2 / 2 號升降機', '載重量 750 公斤 7 人 / MAX. CAPACITY 750kg 7 pers.'. e) MEDIA BEING PLAYED: None. f) AMBIENT AUDIO: Low mechanical hum of the elevator system.
text_visible: 如遇火警 切勿使用升降機
IN CASE OF FIRE DO NOT USE THE LIFT
載重量 750 公斤 7 人
segments.details: I face slightly right toward the elevator control column. The green gaze marker shifts from the center-left door crack across to the button panel.

segments.action: I watch the elevator doors slide open to reveal the 10th floor residential corridor, where XXX walks into the cabin.
segments.action_brief: I watch a passenger enter.
segments.environment: The elevator doors slide open horizontally. Beyond the doors is a brightly lit residential hallway with beige brick-patterned wallpaper, light wooden apartment doors, and light beige ceramic floor tiles. A female resident (XXX) wearing a black jacket, light grey sweatpants, and maroon/pink slippers walks through the doorway into the elevator cabin. An automated bilingual voice announcement chimes and says '升降機門開啟 / Doors opening'.
segments.details: The doors retract fully. XXX steps across the elevator threshold with her right foot forward. My gaze tracks her as she enters.

segments.action: I watch XXX turn towards the control panel and press a floor button with her right hand.
segments.action_brief: I watch the passenger press a button.
segments.environment: XXX turns to face forward towards the elevator control panel on the right wall, reaches her right hand out, and presses one of the lower floor buttons on the column. She then lowers her arms and stands in front of me to the right.
segments.details: XXX stands with her back to me, her dark hair tied in a bun with a scrunchie. My gaze stays fixed on her right arm and the button panel as she selects her destination floor.

segments.action: I watch the elevator sliding doors close.
segments.action_brief: I watch the doors close.
segments.environment: The elevator sliding doors close completely, shutting off the view of the 10th-floor residential corridor. The automated announcement prepares for descent.
segments.details: XXX remains stationary on the right side of the cabin facing the closed doors. My gaze shifts downward toward the lower seam of the elevator doors.

segments.action: I look down at the grey marble floor while holding a small light-green spray bottle with both hands as the elevator descends.
segments.action_brief: I hold a spray bottle.
segments.environment: The elevator begins descending smoothly. An automated bilingual voice announcement broadcasts '升降機開始向下 / Going down' followed by '地下'. Spotlights cast bright oval pools of light onto the grey wood-grain patterned marble floor. XXX stands still on the right in light grey trousers and pink sandals. In the foreground, my hands hold a compact mint-green and white plastic spray bottle near my waist above my grey sneakers and light blue jeans.
segments.details: I look steadily downwards at the marble floor between my feet and XXX's feet. Both of my hands lightly grip the body and nozzle of the small spray dispenser.

1. 取消订阅制，回归按调用量计费。开发
为实际消耗的 Token 付费，不再为“
额度”支付固定成本。
2. 简化模型调用链路。不再做多层封装，开
发者直接对接底层模型能力，调用链更
短，调试更直接。

      "text": "To run the reverse process, start from x_1 ~ N(0, I) and perform num_steps DDPM updates (a hyperparameter), pseudocode below.\nts = linspace(1 - 1e-4, 1e-4, num_steps + 1)\nx = sample_normal\nfor i in range(num_steps):\n    t = ts[i]\n    tm1 = ts[i + 1]\n    eps_hat = model(x, t)\n    x = DDPM_UPDATE(x, eps_hat, t, tm1)\nreturn x\nNote: If you encounter NaNs, you may need to clip sigma_{t-1}^2 - eta_t^2 to 0 if it goes negative, as machine precision issues can make it a very small negative number (e.g. -1e-12) if its too close to 0\nimport torch\nimport torch.nn as nn\nimport torch.optim as optim\nimport torch.nn.functional as F\nimport numpy as np\nfrom torch.utils.data import DataLoader, TensorDataset\n# --- YOUR CODE HERE (MLP Architecture) ---\nclass DiffusionMLP(nn.Module):\n    def __init__(self, in_dim, out_dim, hid, layer):",
      "summary": "VS Code Jupyter Notebook displaying DDPM sampling pseudocode and skeleton code for DiffusionMLP."
    },

      "zoom_index": 1,
      "hkt": "15:10:11",
      "label": "MacBook Laptop Screen - VS Code Jupyter Notebook hw4.ipynb",

5. Optimize the loss L = ||ϵ - έ||_2^2. Here, it suffices to just take the mean over all dimensions.
Note that for the case of continuous-time diffusion, the forward process is x_0 -> 1 and reverse process is 1 -> 0
Use an MLP for f_θ to optimize the loss. You may find the following details helpful.
• Normalize the data using mean and std computed from the train dataset
• Train 100 epochs, batch size 1024, Adam with LR 1e-3 (100 warmup steps, cosine decay to 0)
• MLP with 4 hidden layers and hidden size 64
• Condition on t by concatenating it with input x (i.e. 2D x + 1D t = 3D cat(x, t))
To sample, implement the standard DDPM sampler. You may find the equation from the DDIM paper helpful, rewritten and re-formatted here for convenience.
x_{t-1} = α_{t-1} ((x_t - σ_t έ) / α_t) + √(σ_{t-1}^2 - η_t^2) έ + η_t ϵ_t
where ϵ_t ~ N(0, I) is random Gaussian noise. For DDPM, let
η_t = σ_{t-1}/σ_t √(1 - α_t^2/α_{t-1}^2)
To run the reverse process, start from x_1 ~ N(0, I) and perform num_steps DDPM updates (a hyperparameter), pseudocode below:
ts = linspace(1 - 1e-4, 1e-4, num_steps + 1)
x = sample_normal
for i in range(num_steps):
    t = ts[i]
    tm1 = ts[i + 1]
    eps_hat = model(x, t)
    x = DDPM_UPDATE(x, eps_hat, t, tm1)
return x

segments.environment:
Physical space: An outdoor stone-paved terrace with light gray square tiles surrounded by a black metal railing and lush green trees outside. A dark brown wooden park bench with black metal legs sits along the far railing in the background. The weather is overcast with diffused daylight.
Objects: I sit on a wooden slatted park bench. An open silver MacBook laptop rests on the bench to my left. Next to it on the bench lies a folded red-and-white plaid shirt with a white care label exposed showing laundry symbols and product standards. On my lap rests a white bound paper notepad, and I hold a transparent uni Laknock ballpoint pen with black grip and blue accents in my right hand. A printed fabric bag sits on the bench to my right.
Screen content: MacBook display is partially visible on the left edge.
Text in world: Shirt care label shows '成分：100%棉', '安全类别 GB18401-2010B类', '产品标准：FZ/T81007-2012', and washing instructions. Pen clip displays 'uni Laknock'. Notepad contains handwritten formulas: 'x_{t-1} -> x_t', 'x_t - x_{t-1} 均值', 'x_t = d_t x_{t-1} + \mu_{t-1} ->'.
Media / Ambient audio: Natural outdoor ambient silence with faint background breeze.
segments.details: I carefully write down the transition equations and mean values step-by-step on the top portion of the blank page.

segments.action: I stop writing and glance towards the open MacBook screen resting beside me on the park bench.
segments.action_brief: I glance at the MacBook screen.
segments.environment: The MacBook screen comes fully into view, showing an open full-screen application displaying a dark map / geospatial visualization interface with blue light clusters and satellite overlays. No change to physical surroundings.
segments.details: I lift the pen tip from the paper and hold the notepad loosely with my left hand while checking the screen.

segments.action: I hold the pen poised over the notepad with my right hand while looking down and thinking about the derivation.
segments.action_brief: I contemplate the derivation.
segments.environment: No change.
segments.details: I rest my right hand with the pen hovering slightly above the lower section of the notepad, pausing in thought.

      "text": "Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models\n[Ho, Jain, Abbeel, 2020]\n< 12 / 210 > - 122% +\nq(x_t|x_{t-1}) := N(x_t; sqrt(1 - beta_t)x_{t-1}, beta_t I) (2)\nq(x_{1:T}|x_0) := prod_{t=1}^T q(x_t|x_{t-1})\np_theta(x_{t-1}|x_t) := N(x_{t-1}; mu_theta(x_t, t), Sigma_theta(x_t, t)) (1)\np_theta(x_{0:T}) := p(x_T) prod_{t=1}^T p_theta(x_{t-1}|x_t)\nUC Berkeley - Spring 2024 - Deep Unsupervised Learning - Pieter Abbeel",
      "summary": "Slide 12 showing the graphical model and probability distributions for the forward diffusion q and reverse denoising process p_theta."
    },
    {
      "zoom_index": 9,
      "hkt": "15:27:50",
      "label": "PDF slide on DDPM training and sampling algorithms",
      "text": "Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models\nAlgorithm 1 Training\n1: repeat\n2: x_0 ~ q(x_0)\n3: t ~ Uniform({1, ..., T})\n4: epsilon ~ N(0, I)\n5: Take gradient descent step on nabla_theta ||epsilon - epsilon_theta(sqrt(alpha_bar_t)x_0 + sqrt(1 - alpha_bar_t)epsilon, t)||^2\n6: until converged\nAlgorithm 2 Sampling\n1: x_T ~ N(0, I)\n2: for t = T, ..., 1 do\n3: z ~ N(0, I) if t > 1, else z = 0\n4: x_{t-1} = 1/sqrt(alpha_t) (x_t - (1 - alpha_t)/sqrt(1 - alpha_bar_t) epsilon_theta(x_t, t)) + sigma_t z\n5: end for\n6: return x_0\nepsilon_theta approx sigma nabla_x log p_theta(x)\n< 13 / 210 > - 122% +",
      "summary": "Slide 13 detailing the pseudocode for Algorithm 1 (Training) and Algorithm 2 (Sampling) from Ho et al., 2020."
    },
    {
      "zoom_index": 14,
      "hkt": "15:27:55",

• η_t = 0 时是 deterministic DDIM；η_t > 0 时恢复随机采样。DDIM 论文强调的正是这种从随机到确定性的连续家族。

screen_text.label: ChatGPT DDIM Formula Derivation
screen_text.text:
这也是 DDPM 原论文的核心 closed form，DDIM 论文则是在“保持相同训练目标”的前提下，把采样过程推广成更一般的、甚至可确定性的形式。
先看第1步：由模型预测噪声反推出 x_0。
既然 x_t = \alpha_t x_0 + \sigma_t \epsilon,
把真实噪声 \epsilon 换成网络预测 \hat{\epsilon}，就得到
\hat{x}_0 = \frac{x_t - \sigma_t \hat{\epsilon}}{\alpha_t}
screen_text.summary: ChatGPT explanation showing step 1 of deriving the clean image estimate in DDIM.

screen_text.label: ChatGPT DDIM Noise Decomposition
screen_text.text:
在 t-1 时刻，边缘分布应当满足
x_{t-1} = \alpha_{t-1} x_0 + \sigma_{t-1} \epsilon'
其中 \epsilon' \sim \mathcal{N}(0, I)。
但采样时我们没有真 x_0，只有 \hat{x}_0。所以先代入 \hat{x}_0，得到“信号部分” \alpha_{t-1}\hat{x}_0。
剩下要处理的是噪声部分 \sigma_{t-1}\epsilon'。DDIM的关键想法是：把它拆成两块：
- 一块沿着当前模型预测到的噪声方向 \hat{\epsilon}
- 一块是真正重新采样的独立高斯噪声 \epsilon_t \sim \mathcal{N}(0, I)。
于是写成 \sigma_{t-1}\epsilon' = \sqrt{\sigma_{t-1}^2 - \eta^2}\hat{\epsilon} + \eta\epsilon_t
screen_text.summary: ChatGPT explanation breaking down the noise term into predicted and stochastic components.

screen_text.label: ChatGPT DDIM Step Update Formula
screen_text.text:
因为两块方差加起来正好是 (\sigma_{t-1}^2 - \eta^2) + \eta^2 = \sigma_{t-1}^2
所以总噪声尺度仍然正确。

text: 剩下要处理的是噪声部分 σ_{t-1}ε'。DDIM的关键想法是：把它拆成两块，

Question 1: Toy Dataset [30pt]
Execute the cell below to visualize our datasets.
visualize_q1_dataset()
Given a data element x and neural net f_theta(x, t), implement the following diffusion training steps:
1. Sample the diffusion timestep: t ~ Uniform(0, 1)
2. Compute the noise-strength following a cosine schedule: alpha_t = cos(t), sigma_t = sin(t)
3. Apply the forward process - Sample noise epsilon ~ N(0, I) (same shape as x) and compute noised x_t = alpha_t x + sigma_t epsilon
4. Estimate epsilon_hat = f_theta(x_t, t)
5. Optimize the loss L = ||epsilon - epsilon_hat||^2. Here, it suffices to just take the mean over all dimensions.
Use an MLP for f_theta to optimize the loss. You may find the following details helpful:
- Normalize the data using mean and std computed from the train dataset
- Train 100 epochs, batch size 1024, Adam with LR 1e-3 (100 warmup steps, cosine decay to 0)
- MLP with 4 hidden layers and hidden size 64
- Condition on t by concatenating it with input x (i.e. 2D x + 1D t = 3D cat(x, t))

screen_text.label: MacBook screen - Diffusion model assignment instructions
text: For code simplicity, we will train a continuous-time variant of the diffusion prompt. In practice training objectives and code between discrete-time and continuous-time diffusion models are similar.
Given a data element x and neural net f_θ(x, t), implement the following diffusion training steps:
1. Sample the diffusion timestep: t ~ Uniform(0, 1)
2. Compute the noise-strength following a cosine schedule: α_t = cos(π/2 t), σ_t = sin(π/2 t)
3. Apply the forward process - Sample noise ε ~ N(0, I) (same shape as x) and compute noised x_t = α_t x + σ_t ε
5. Optimize the loss L = ||ε - ε̂||^2. Here, it suffices to just take the mean over all dimensions.
Note that for the case of continuous-time diffusion, the forward process is x_0 and reverse process is ...
Use an MLP for f_θ to optimize the loss. You may find the following details helpful.
• Normalize the data using mean and std computed from the train dataset
• Train 100 epochs, batch size 1024, Adam with LR 1e-3 (100 warmup steps, cosine decay to 0)
• MLP with 4 hidden layers and hidden size 64
• Condition on t by concatenating it with input x (i.e. 2D x + 1D t = 3D cat(x, t))

screen_text.label: ChatGPT DDIM/DDPM Variance Derivation
text: 这里 ηt 就是“你想让这一步有多随机”的旋钮：
ηt = 0 时是 deterministic DDIM；ηt > 0 时恢复随机采样。DDIM 论文强调的正是这种从随机到确定性的连续家族。
接下来就是你最关心的：为什么对 DDPM 要取
答案是：为了让这一步的随机项方差，恰好等于 DDPM 真正后验 q(x_{t-1}|x_t, x_0) 的方差。
DDPM 原论文给出 q(x_{t-1}|x_t, x_0) = N(\tilde{\mu}_t, \tilde{\beta}_t I), \tilde{\beta}_t = \frac{1-\bar{\alpha}_{t-1}}{1-\bar{\alpha}_t} \beta_t
所以如果我们想让这个 DDIM 形式退化成标准 DDPM 采样器，就应当令新注入的噪声方差满足 σt^2 = \tilde{\beta}_t
